name: NHH Norwegian School of Economics
summary: Public business school in Bergen; one English bachelor's, in business, economics and data science, with a guaranteed place on NHH's two-year master's.

handoff.label: Admission: Bachelor in Business, Economics and Data Science

ib.text: IB Diploma with Maths AA or AI (SL or HL), and English A at grade 3 or English B at grade 5. EU/EEA applicants can get a conditional offer on official predicted grades.

apply.via: Søknadsweb, or Samordna opptak if you have Danish A

dates.label: Søknadsweb deadline, with official IB predicted grades, 23:59 CET
With Danish, Norwegian or Swedish A: Samordna opptak opens
With Danish, Norwegian or Swedish A: Samordna opptak deadline
dates.short: With Danish, Norwegian or Swedish A

dates.label: Samordna route, IB: set up the IBO Request for Results with your coordinator (no upload)

programmes.name: Bachelor in Business, Economics and Data Science
programmes.about: Business administration and economics with more maths, applied statistics, programming, automation and AI than a standard business degree; each semester is built around a theme such as consumers, the firm, markets or sustainability.
programmes.ib: Any IB maths (AA or AI, SL or HL); English A at 3 or English B at 5. With Danish, Norwegian or Swedish A you must apply through Samordna opptak.

needs.note: Grade 3 is Samordna opptak's floor; the OMPT-F maths test also counts on the Søknadsweb route.

programmes.selectionNote: Samordna opptak ranks you on your IB total, converted with its table (41 points = 58.6, 42 = 59.3), plus science points. NHH does not say how it ranks Søknadsweb.

notes: If you have Danish, Norwegian or Swedish A at grade 3 or better, NHH says you should apply through Samordna opptak, by 15 April, not through Søknadsweb.
Predicted grades are compulsory in the Søknadsweb round: official, stamped and signed, with a predicted total including TOK and EE.
EU/EEA decisions in the Søknadsweb round come in May, and you must accept within two weeks of the offer.
